reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text:
I literally never leave reviews for apps, but I had to for this one. I’m on week 7 and the changes I’ve seen are actually amazing. I’ve told everyone about this app lol.

The biggest thing I’ve learned is that you really have to go into the settings and customize everything to YOU. Your goals, preferences, lifestyle, all of it. Once I did that, it stopped feeling like I was trying to follow some impossible diet and it became something that actually fits into my normal life.

I can still eat foods I actually like, go out to eat, and make adjustments without feeling like I ruined my entire day. It’s honestly changed the way I look at food and dieting in general. 7 weeks in and I’m still using it every single day. Definitely worth trying, just CUSTOMIZE YOUR SETTINGS!!

reviews.title: Buggy app: Paid for an annual subscription, locked out with no support response
reviews.text:
As it stands I can not recommend this app. In the few months on it they keep taking away features I initially enjoyed the app for and now I can’t even log in: it’s prompting me to pay again even though my subscription is active through next year. Support hasn’t responded yet. I feel like I wasted my money.

Update: I did reach out to support several times before they sent that follow up below. Never heard back from anyone. That’s the flaw of an AI company: no humans available to troubleshoot. Anyway after over a month of silence and not being able to access the app I paid upfront for a year I got in touch with Apple and got a full refund on the membership. This company should really offer free trials and I wouldn’t recommend paying for it for a year upfront. Get a preview. The app had promise but right now it’s way too buggy and the UI is changing way too drastically and too often to use it as a consistent weight loss program. The tracking features are also incorrect and AI doesn’t remember the macros for the protein shakes I log *every day* lol I ended up still doing all my logging in MyFitness Pal which I’ve since returned to using as a primary tool.

reviews.title: Protein shakes
reviews.text: I bought a year subscription to actually try it out after my trial period. Over the past three to four months the app has made many updates mostly in the area of UI and each time I had to relearn it over again but the underlying advice from AI is that it tells me everyday is to drink two protein shakes a day.  I constantly ask for wholesome real food meals and it keeps going on about protein shakes. As a women going through perimenopause I can’t be drinking protein shakes everyday. I want real food instead of some processed powder in milk/water. Other than that I liked talking to the AI coach but at times it can get frustrating. Also they keep saying they will fix the weight tracker that is supposed to take it from your health app but it never does so I have been manually entering it to this day. Support only answered me once and never got back to me since. I have an electronic weight scale and it records it to Apple Health.  However I am losing weight but as mentioned I have to specifically ask for the meal plan. If you do not ask it will give you the generic protein shake meal plan.

reviews.title: Misleading. Just use a free alternative
reviews.text:
You have to pay to access just about everything, which they’re not very upfront about. They only tell you AFTER you’ve taken all the time to give them your info and fill out their quiz that you have to pay to access anything.
It isn’t even a “pay for premium” deal where you can still access basic info. You have to pay for the AI, the plans, the advice, ANYTHING. I sincerely doubt it’s any better than giving the same info to ChatGPT (or another free alternative) and allowing it to create a FREE plan for you.
